findings:
🔴 [receipt-forgery] MUST-FIX The gate trusts receipt.verdict, phase_base_sha, and receipt.chain without reading canonical chain.json, findings, seat outputs, or dispositions; a handcrafted SHIP-AS-IS receipt using base=head=current branch and an empty-diff hash passes with no review. Supply the trusted phase base, bind the receipt to canonical immutable artifacts, and rederive verdict/open findings from validated dispositions per ADR-0001.
🔴 [disposition-fail-open] MUST-FIX finalize converts malformed findings/disposition structures to empty arrays and never validates disposition enums or duplicate IDs; a Critical finding paired with a misspelled disposition is treated as unverified and yields SHIP-AS-IS. Strictly validate arrays, unique nonempty IDs, severities, and verified/refuted/deferred before aggregation.
🔴 [emoji-finding-loss] MUST-FIX extractFindings does not match canonical emoji-only lines such as “🔴 [id] MUST-FIX” because the trailing word boundary cannot follow the emoji/whitespace alternative, silently dropping Critical findings. Correct the parser, cover all four canonical forms, and reject nonempty unparseable reviewed output.
🟠 [artifact-immutability] MUST-FIX collect overwrites existing generation artifacts, appends duplicate generations, and resets malformed chain JSON to an empty chain; finalize similarly tolerates corrupt chains and references a mutable external dispositions file. Refuse reused generations, fail closed on chain corruption, use atomic/exclusive writes, and snapshot/hash-bind dispositions inside gN.
🟠 [uncollected-finalize] MUST-FIX finalize succeeds without a collected chain entry or valid range.json and fabricates a finalized entry with blank base/head; current tests explicitly bless this producer/consumer drift. Require a matching pending gN chain/range artifact before finalization and add a collect→finalize→gate integration test.
🟠 [optout-provenance] MUST-FIX opt-out validation compares the resolver’s provenance field to the literal “off”, ignores receipt.resolved_from, and permits an arbitrary or missing config_source path with an empty-file hash. Re-derive only the knob value as off, compare provenance to the receipt and actual source, require the allowed knob set and existing source, and verify its exact hash.
🟠 [plan-freeze-malformed-pass] MUST-FIX plan-artifact mode treats missing/non-array findings as an empty valid set, so malformed `{}` artifacts can pass the freeze gate. Validate both top-level schemas, unique IDs, candidate_blocker booleans, and disposition enums before evaluating the predicate.
🟠 [dispatch-trust-status] MUST-FIX collect executes dispatch-review.sh from the target repository instead of the specified trusted PATH shim and ignores the child exit status; a reviewed branch can replace the driver, or a nonzero process can emit reviewed JSON and be accepted. Resolve a trusted explicit/PATH dispatcher and require zero exit plus a strict result schema.
🟡 [scaffold-exclusive-create] MUST-FIX plan-rubric-scaffold checks existence separately from writing, allowing a concurrently created output to be overwritten despite the untouched-existing-output contract. Create with exclusive `wx` semantics and translate EEXIST to exit 2.
